correctness.rationale: The complete frozen proof was independently reconstructed: the first syzygy of DA is the radical trace-zero hyperplane of dimension r^2-1; later projective ranks multiply by r. Tensor differential ranks are r in degree one and beta_(n-1) thereafter, giving r(r^2-2) and (r^2-1)^2 r^(n-2) in every characteristic. The full primary Theorem 4.1 and its complete proof are now read: they explicitly assert eventual zero homology and use finite good truncations to infer automatic convergence for arbitrary finite-dimensional A. The example has quotient A/rad(A)=k, so meets separability, and disproves that premise. Bounded-above projective models are not confused with finite homological amplitude. No assertion is made that all conclusions or all unbounded spectral sequences fail.
